description: Parse a Lightyear account statement CSV. Returns summary by default; set include_rows=true for trade/distribution details.

date_from.description: Only include entries from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: Only include entries up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

file_path.description: AccountStatement path/base64 input. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

include_rows.description: Include individual trade/distribution rows (default false — summary only)

name: parse_lightyear_statement
title: Parse Lightyear Account Statement
